item.title: People Are Falling Into The 'AI Yelling Food' Video Hole And Learning A Few Things In The Process

item.title: It's Been Two Decades Since The First 'Diabeetus' Meme Appeared Online
item.description: Diabeetus is an exploitable soundbite based on a television advertisement for the medical supplies company Liberty Medical. Featuring the American actor Wilford Brimley who repeatedly mispronounces "diabetes" as "dia-beetus," the infomercial inspired numerous remixes and image macros.

item.title: Five Years Ago, Zoomers Replaced The Laughing Emoji With The Skull Emoji
item.description: Skull Emoji 💀 is the image of a human skull included in the emoji deck of all text message platforms. While initially commonplace around Halloween each year after its introduction in the early 2010s, the emoji took on new meaning in the early 2020s as it saw use among Generation Z social media users as slang to express "I'm dead from laughing."
